stem: Find the value(s) of the constant $a$ for which the quadratic equation $x^2-(a+1)x+4=0$ has a repeated solution. Tap the value(s) of $a$ on the number line.

hints.text: Taking a square root gives two cases, positive and negative.
Solve $a+1=\text{each root}$ carefully for $a$; check the sign of the value you subtract.
Start from the condition $D=0$ for a repeated solution, then check each value by substituting it into $D$.
